landing.headline: Build what's next.
landing.subheadline: Find the people who should be building it with you.
landing.description: An intelligent professional network that connects people through the projects, ideas, research and opportunities they care about.
landing.features_desc: Move beyond static resumes and noisy feeds. NEXUS focuses on what you can build, the skills you have, and the impact you want to make.
landing.f1_desc: Our AI semantic search understands what you want to build and connects you with the exact skills you're missing.
landing.f2_desc: Don't just list where you worked. Showcase what you're building right now and find collaborators in real-time.
landing.f3_desc: A curated feed focused on milestones, product launches, and deep-tech research, not corporate posturing.
landing.f4_desc: Find specialized funding, research grants, and technical co-founders across the world without traditional gatekeepers.
